$comment: Built at the TARGET pin f45a517a9 through v4's REAL repositories, so every
cell of 512 bytes or more is a brotli BLOB v4's own documentToRow wrote.
Its purpose is the drift ledger's failure (b) — 'Create Backup succeeds with
non-zero llm_logs' — which no other family can prove: every one that could
reads a committed fixture the round's §R.12 forbids rebuilding.
Sizes are deliberate: each registered column has a row ABOVE the floor and,
where the column is repeated, one BELOW it, so the same column holds a MIX.
